items.text: Listing 25.1 (App F, #code-25-1): the last assertion fails because the cycle regex requires whitespace after 'means'. Fix the regex in the listing (and its prose description in Ch 25 if it quotes the regex), and run the listing to confirm all assertions pass.
Listing 28.8 (App F) sets "sharpe": 2.0 while revised §28.9 uses 0.7 with a standard error. Set it to 0.7, re-run, and reconcile every §28.9 number quoted from the listing's output.

Listing 11.5's demo runs for several minutes; give it a smaller default grid (keep the full grid behind a flag) so it runs in under 30 seconds, and make sure the Ch 11 prose about its output still holds.

Listing numbers can run out of chapter order (Ch 1: 1.1, 1.2, 1.4, 1.3) and some auto titles are weak ('Listing 1.4: Eq', 'Listing 9-B.1: OLS of y on [1, x]', 'Listing 17-B.1: Share of shares outstanding repurchased...'). Write tools/renumber_listings.py that renumbers each chapter's listings in the order their links appear in the chapter, rewriting App F headings, anchors and every link in book_src/ consistently (dry run by default, --apply to write), run it, and give weak titles a real one drawn from the chapter's prose. If a safe renumber is not possible, log deferred with the reason and only fix the titles.

Date clash: 23 October in Ch 24 versus Ch 19 and Ch 21 (verify Ch 24). Read the three passages and the story clock in state/cast_bible.md (read only; another agent edits it), and fix whichever chapter is out of line.

Ch 24 §24.7: PB-03's $0.75mm total leaves out financing; with financing the capture ratio is about 0.6, not two-thirds (Ch 8 §8.4). Recompute and reconcile Ch 24 with Ch 8 §8.4 (and state/rv_pair_book.md's PB-03 row if it quotes the number).
Ch 8 repeats the SVB 8-K attribution error fixed in Ch 4-B (see state/revisions/ed2/04_ch04b*.verify.md or grep Ch 4-B for the corrected wording). Fix Ch 8 to match.
Ch 19 §19.8.2: the hand estimates 'roughly 74bp ... about 35bp' differ from Figure 19.5's 76/37bp. Align the text with the figure or say why they differ, in one clause.
Ch 12 states 99.8% for the whole $1.4bn Blue Owl sale; the press-release average was 99.7% (verify Ch 26). Check the dossier and reconcile Ch 12 with Ch 26.

Ch 16 §16.2 (around line 176) says 'Chapter 1's box in §1.8.1 has the same curve for price pressure'; that box is now a two-sentence gloss in §1.8.1 and the half-life box lives in Ch 9 §9.4. Reword to point at both.

An Ares quote whose speaker and wording the sources disagree on was removed from Ch 25, but Ch 17 and state/research/perspectives_buyside_credit_managers.md still carry it. Re-verify it against a primary source (transcript, letter or the outlet's page); if it cannot be verified verbatim with the speaker, replace it in Ch 17 with an attributed paraphrase or remove it, and mark the dossier entry UNVERIFIED.
§26.8 cites 'OCC Bulletin 2011-12' (SR 11-7's OCC counterpart). Verify the bulletin number and title against occ.gov or federalreserve.gov (SR 11-7 itself names it); fix or hedge.

Ch 22 Resource Graph: the Uyeda speech figures must be checked against the SEC page (sec.gov returned 403 to scripted fetch). Try fetching the speech page or a reliable mirror; if still unverifiable, hedge the figures to what the dossier supports and note the source.

Ch 1 Resource Graphs (§1.8 and §1.10): the Odd Lots entries are still channel-level (no episode titles, dates or URLs). Replace each with a specific episode from state/research/media_specific_items*.md or media_podcasts_credit_quant.md (title, date, URL already verified there); do not invent episodes.

Ch 3 §3.4 SVB coda: the Bloomberg (2 Jul 2024) '40% or better' recovery for creditors owed $3.5bn is hedged as 'press reports put'; confirm the exact wording and figure from a source (dossier or web) and tighten or keep the hedge.

Ch 3 §3.7 'After the announcement': the remand's mitigation figures (29%–43% of observed volume vs $62mm–$94mm) did not reconcile with the $186mm volume. Recompute from the chapter's own inputs and fix the arithmetic or the wording. Also: §3.7 promises a Serta first-lien flow event study as future work; leave the promise unless it reads as a broken cross-reference.

Ch 4 has three figure embeds with no PNG: pod_fee_waterfall (the RV thread's pass-through fee waterfall), etrading_timeline, genealogy (grep -n 'ch04_' book_src/04_ch04_inside_the_systematic_credit_industry.md and python3 tools/check_figures.py). Draw them in tools/figures/ch04.py (append; house style; Illustrative unless sourced) to match their captions, run it, and open each PNG.

Cast bible items (state/cast_bible.md; you are the only agent editing it): Theo's start date (bible says Tue 22 Sep 2026; the 4-D brief said Mon 21 Sep; check which the chapters use and make all agree); Kaz's fulcrum misread breaks rule C7 (log a ruling); log the Vantress interview, Owen's email and Theo's ROBO; Ch 1-B's 'Ep 29' link should be Ep 15 (fix in Ch 1-B after checking the dossier); the TRACE $70.2bn figure is unverified (hedge where used); 00_02 dates Theo's offer to Sunday 28 June 2026 (per 4-D): reconcile.

Columbus Day (Mon 12 Oct 2026, a bond-market holiday) conflicts with the story clock's business-day counts in Ch 8-C and Ch 21. Reconcile with state/cast_bible.md's story clock: fix the day counts in the chapters (smallest change) and record the holiday in the bible.

Ch 7-B §7-B.8 and exercise 5 quote 17.1% for the monthly grid (a continuity-correction approximation) while the simulation, the acceptance test and Figure 7-B.5 give a different value. Recompute and make the text, exercise and figure agree (say which method each number uses).

Ch 7-B §7-B.6: the Bohn–Stein claim 'about half of the time ... 20 bps vs 200 bps' does not follow from the stated one-factor parameters. Re-derive with python3 and either re-parameterize the example or restate the claim to match.
Ch 4-B Table 4B.1 shows 679 where the listing gives 678.5. Make the table and listing agree (rounding note or the value).
Ch 2-B §2B.4 has a K/F contradiction (see state/revisions/ed2/02_ch02b_transaction_cost_analysis_for_credit.figcheck.md), and the n=19 stress bucket in §2B.5's table is thin: say so in the text.

Ch 10 §10.2.3: delete 'ISDA notes that the roll window carries 25–50% of quarterly index notional' (no source found) and cite ICE's week ending 24 Sep 2021 instead, as the cleanup-queue entry from the 10-B writer specifies (read it in full); keep Ch 10-B's cross-reference consistent.

Ch 15 after Listings 15.1–15.2: the prose cited 18–19 points, 'mid-80s' survival and a 1.2x EBITDA threshold while the code prints 15.55 points and 81% survival. The App Z fix pass corrected some of this (state/revisions/ed2/15_ch15_event_driven_mna_and_coc.appz_fix.md); check what remains and finish it.
